verdict.rationale: Moneybird is an accounting SaaS that handles customer data, and it exposes MCP and AI-chat channels, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used for AI model training or offers any opt-out control or policy. The authentication, API, sandbox and MCP materials do not cover this subject.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
